name: Memory Graph — Universal Prior + Posterior Delta
description: Typed dissent-preserving prior contract for multi-agent OpenClaw. Adds prior-capsule, posterior-delta, compaction-record, and dissent-record node types to the memory-graph SQLite store with append-only + dissent-preservation invariants enforced as schema validators.

freshnessWindowMinutes.label: Read-marker freshness window (minutes)
freshnessWindowMinutes.help: How long a per-voice read marker is considered fresh before the voice is told the prior advanced.

circuitBreakerThreshold.label: Compaction circuit-breaker threshold
circuitBreakerThreshold.help: How many proposed compactions can fail validation before the proposer voice is locked out.

synthesizerCandidatePool.label: Synthesizer candidate pool
synthesizerCandidatePool.help: Voice ids eligible to sign compaction-records as approver. Cross-family discipline applies: approver family must differ from majority contributor family.
